boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Florida Southern College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops with directly verified late hours, spanning campus counters and Lakeland destinations.

cards.entity_name: Steak 'N Shake at Florida Southern College
cards.title: The 1 A.M. Campus Counter
cards.subtitle: Campus dining with an extra-late midweek window
cards.notes: Check the semester schedule before walking over; Wednesday and Thursday service extends to 1 a.m., while other nights end earlier.
cards.short_summary: FSC’s latest scheduled campus dining window belongs to its Steak 'N Shake counter on Wednesday and Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College lists Steak 'N Shake service until 1:00 a.m. on Wednesday and Thursday during the semester.
cards.source_title: Florida Southern College Portal — Dining Location Hours
cards.access_notes: Semester hours list Wednesday–Thursday service from 4:30 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.; Monday, Tuesday, Friday, and weekends close at 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Convenience Stop
cards.subtitle: Grab-and-go supplies beneath Wynee’s Bistro
cards.notes: Use this stop for packaged food or drinks before 11 p.m.; leave backpacks outside as required by the dining-services notice.
cards.short_summary: The campus convenience store provides a consistent 11 p.m. option every day of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College identifies Moc Mart as a campus convenience store and lists closing time as 11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Office of Dining Services — Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; backpacks are not allowed inside.

cards.title: Coffee Before the 11 P.M. Close
cards.subtitle: A late weekday café inside the campus routine
cards.notes: Plan this run for Monday through Thursday, when the café reaches 11 p.m.; Friday and weekend closing times are substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: Tutu’s combines café service with FSC’s latest regular Monday-through-Thursday study-hour dining window.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College lists Tutu’s Cyber Café as open until 11:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Florida Southern College Portal — Dining Location Hours
cards.access_notes: Semester hours are Monday–Thursday 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; Friday 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Sunday 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.

cards.title: An 11 P.M. Deli Run
cards.subtitle: Late food service at College Terrace
cards.notes: Head to College Terrace before the posted 11 p.m. close; confirm the portal schedule when semester breaks may alter campus service.
cards.short_summary: Healthy Blend Deli maintains an 11 p.m. closing time across both weekday and weekend schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College lists Healthy Blend Deli as open until 11:00 p.m. seven days a week during the semester.
cards.source_title: Florida Southern College Portal — Dining Location Hours
cards.access_notes: Semester hours are Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Smoothies Until 11 P.M.
cards.subtitle: A second late counter at College Terrace
cards.notes: Choose Freshens when its menu fits the night, and arrive before 11 p.m.; consult the college portal for break-related schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: Freshens gives College Terrace another independently named counter operating until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College lists Freshens as open until 11:00 p.m. every day during the semester.
cards.source_title: Florida Southern College Portal — Dining Location Hours
cards.access_notes: Semester hours are Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 3605 South Florida Avenue
cards.title: The 4 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A South Florida Avenue option south of campus
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest window; dine-in closes earlier, so verify the service mode shown on the location page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: This South Florida Avenue location offers overnight drive-thru service, with an even later Friday–Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 4:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at this address.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3605 South Florida Avenue, Lakeland
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 4:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: The All-Night Dining Room
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour restaurant on South Florida Avenue
cards.notes: Use this location when a seated meal is useful after other kitchens close; its official page lists dine-in and continuous 24-hour operation.
cards.short_summary: The nearby South Florida Avenue IHOP provides a verified all-night dine-in option rather than only a drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 3447 South Florida Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in available.
cards.source_title: IHOP Late Night Food — 3447 South Florida Avenue
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; the official location page identifies dine-in, takeout, and late-night food service.

cards.title: Breakfast Around the Clock
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 diner farther south on Florida Avenue
cards.notes: Keep this diner in reserve for hours when campus service has ended; check the live location page before making the longer trip south.
cards.short_summary: This Florida Avenue South diner supplies another directly verified 24-hour seated-food option in Lakeland.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s describes its 4325 Florida Avenue South restaurant as open 24/7 and lists daily hours from 12:00 a.m. to 11:58 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open around the clock seven days a week; the official listing displays each day as 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A late carryout and ordering option east of campus
cards.notes: Check the live store page before ordering because its closing display is day-sensitive; the verified listing showed service through 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: The South Bartow Road Domino’s extends a straightforward pizza-ordering option past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 1523 S. Bartow Road showed the Lakeland store open until 1:00 a.m. when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino’s Pizza — 1523 S. Bartow Road, Lakeland
cards.access_notes: The official, day-sensitive store listing showed “Today Until 1:00 AM” when fetched; recheck the page for the intended night.

cards.title: The Daily 1 A.M. Close
cards.subtitle: Late lobby and drive-thru hours south of campus
cards.notes: Allow extra travel time from FSC and verify the locator before departure; both the lobby and drive-thru are listed through 1 a.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: This south Lakeland McDonald’s has a consistent 1 a.m. close for both indoor and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours through 1:00 a.m. every day at its 4805 Florida Avenue S location.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru close at 1:00 a.m. daily; opening is 5:00 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 6:00 a.m. Sunday.

warnings: Campus dining hours are labeled as semester hours and may change during academic breaks.
Domino’s displays day-sensitive closing information; users should recheck the direct store page for their intended night.
The McDonald’s source URL contains a legacy address slug, while the rendered official listing identifies the destination as 4805 Florida Avenue S.
